searchText: Just saw this too: https://twitter.com/hosseeb/status/1569166679850250241 About FCFS ordering mechanisms: https://writings.flashbots.net/research/fcfs-and-front-running Incredible 💯 Thanks for sharing Alex! Will go through both of these. And yes saw those stats actually that are cited in that presentation--I think the big/complex arbs & MEV bundles still skew everything such that on a $ (or maybe also ETH?) denominated basis, miners still don't capture the majority of MEV economics. Btw do you prefer I raise questions/ask here or DM you on twitter (or some other venue)? Lmk whatever is convenient/preferable for you good to know dragonfly is also MEV-curious <:shipit:636891691927732224> Yeah this was an excellent post. Increasingly coming to the conclusion (maybe slower than everyone here) that MEV is something to manage + goal is to design market mechanisms to re-distribute rather than eliminate. There's a curious trade-off here between permissionless-ness vs. magnitude of MEV externality. Worry that mechanisms that attempt to "eliminate it" end up re-creating the permissioned, infrastructure arms-race (via colocation, better networking etc) we've seen in traditional exchange venues. IEX (you may have heard of it from Flash Boys) for example introduces a speed bump in an attempt to level the playing field: https://www.wealthmanagement.com/markets/iex-outduels-citadel-nyse-flash-boys-exchange-approved

excerpts.content:
Yeah this was an excellent post. Increasingly coming to the conclusion (maybe slower than everyone here) that MEV is something to manage + goal is to design market mechanisms to re-distribute rather than eliminate. 

There's a curious trade-off here between permissionless-ness vs. magnitude of MEV externality. Worry that mechanisms that attempt to "eliminate it" end up re-creating the permissioned, infrastructure arms-race (via colocation, better networking etc) we've seen in traditional exchange venues. IEX (you may have heard of it from Flash Boys) for example introduces a speed bump in an attempt to level the playing field: https://www.wealthmanagement.com/markets/iex-outduels-citadel-nyse-flash-boys-exchange-approved
